Birthdays

A birthday countdown that starts again every year

Your own birthday, your partner's, your mum's, your best friend's: put the days left on your Home Screen and get a nudge a week before, while there's still time for a gift. Each birthday countdown starts again by itself the day after.

Add a birthday in a few seconds

  1. Ask Siri: "Add a countdown in Simple Count", then say "Mom's birthday March 12". Simple Count picks 🎂 and makes it repeat every year by itself. Or tap + in the app, set the date and set Repeat to yearly.
  2. Or import them: Import from Calendar turns events from your calendar into countdowns, and a birthday that repeats there keeps repeating here.
  3. Add the widget to your Home Screen or Lock Screen. How to add the widget.

Never miss one again

  • Reminders before the day: add one 7 days before for the gift and one 1 day before for the card. They come back every year with the birthday.
  • All birthdays in one place: give every birthday the 🎂 emoji and search for 🎂 to list them all.
  • The next one on your Home Screen: the Next Event widget always shows the closest countdown, so the next birthday shows up by itself. Or set a widget to one person's birthday.
  • On your wrist: the Apple Watch app and watch face complications show the next birthday too.

Planning a party or a surprise

  • Count down together: share the countdown with the friends who are in on it. Everyone sees the same countdown and notes on their own phone, widgets included. Sharing one countdown is free.
  • Gift ideas and plans in the notes: a checklist for the party shopping, a section for gift ideas you hear about during the year.
  • A photo of them on the widget: put a favourite photo behind the day count (photo backgrounds are part of Pro, a one-time purchase).
  • On the day: confetti on the countdown, and with a time set, a live countdown to the party on the Lock Screen in the last eight hours.

Questions

Does a birthday countdown reset after the birthday?

Yes, when it repeats yearly. Siri sets that by itself for birthdays; in the app, set Repeat to yearly. The day after, it starts counting to next year's.

Is the birthday countdown widget free?

Yes. Every widget in Simple Count is free, in every size, on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen, with no ads and no subscription.

Can I get a reminder before a birthday?

Yes. Add reminders like 7 days or 1 day before. For a repeating birthday they come back every year.

Can friends see the same countdown for a surprise party?

Yes. Share it with Count Down Together and everyone sees the same countdown and notes, kept up to date on every phone. Joining is always free.
